```move
public fun set_participant_vesting<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut PresaleInitializer<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    vesting_terms: blast_core::payout::VestingTerms,
)

/// Sets the Quote the sale raises and each recipient's share of it, paid at migration. The LP
/// keeps what Blast's and the recipients' shares leave.
public fun set_raise<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut PresaleInitializer<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    raise_target: u64,
    raise_allocations: vector<RecipientShare>,
)

/// Sets how long commitments stay open from the start, and how long after the window anyone may
/// migrate a funded sale before anyone may cancel it: at least seven days.
public fun set_windows<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut PresaleInitializer<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    commitment_duration_ms: u64,
    liquidity_window_duration_ms: u64,
)

/// Sets who may commit and each wallet's cap.
public fun set_eligibility<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut PresaleInitializer<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    eligibility: EligibilityPolicy,
)

/// Adds a closing phase that lifts wallet caps. Without one, caps hold for the whole window.
public fun set_uncapped_phase<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut PresaleInitializer<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    uncapped: UncappedPhase,
)

/// Hard-caps the sale at its raise from `start_delay_ms` into the window: zero for the whole
/// window, or the uncapped phase's offset to keep an overflowing capped phase before it. With
/// `closes_when_filled`, anyone may settle the sale once its raise is full under the hard cap;
/// without it, a full sale waits for the window's end. Without a hard cap, the sale overflows
/// for the whole window and always runs to its end.
public fun set_hard_cap<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut PresaleInitializer<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    start_delay_ms: u64,
    closes_when_filled: bool,
)

/// Sets how the sale's vault splits every collected LP fee after Blast's share: any of the core
/// routes, including the sale owner, auto-LP, holder rewards, and burn.
public fun set_fee_split<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut PresaleInitializer<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    fee_split: blast_core::fee_split::FeeSplit,
)

/// Names the sale's Blast partner, one the `CreationPolicy` lets new presales name; from
/// `finalize` on it is the sale's partner for good. The partner earns its cut of Blast's raise and
/// token fees, which migration holds until `pay_protocol_fees_with_partner` pays them, and its
/// vault inherits the partner, which then earns its cut of Blast's LP fees (ADR 0137).
public fun set_partner<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut PresaleInitializer<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    creation_policy: &creation_policy::CreationPolicy,
    partner: &blast_partners::blast_partners::Partner,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// The venue witness type the sale migrates to, so a venue finalizing an initializer it is
/// handed can confirm the sale is its own.
public fun venue<SaleToken, Quote>(self: &PresaleInitializer<SaleToken, Quote>): TypeName

/// Requires a confirmed unregulated sale currency and checks every setting, then mints and
/// apportions the complete token supply and
/// irreversibly makes it fixed or burn-only before returning the presale for `share`.
public fun finalize<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: PresaleInitializer<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    registry: &mut PresaleRegistry,
    currency: &mut Currency<SaleToken>,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): (Presale<SaleToken, Quote>, PresaleCap)

/// Shares a newly created presale and fixes its windows from `commitment_starts_at_ms`, or from now once that
/// has passed, so a sale can be created ahead of its start. Commitments open at the start; until
/// then Blast's `FeeAdmin` may change the sale's Blast rates.
public fun share<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: Presale<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    commitment_starts_at_ms: u64,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Replaces this sale's snapshot of Blast's rates before its window starts, while nobody can have
/// committed: in its creation transaction before `share`, or once shared until its start. Once
/// shared the sale is public, so each rate may only stay or fall; only the creation transaction
/// may raise one, up to the applied fee policy. A changed token rate reapportions Blast's tokens
/// against the buyers' sale allocation and a changed raise rate its Quote against the LP's, each
/// rounded down; an unchanged rate keeps its amount, and every recipient keeps its amount.
public fun set_protocol_fees<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut Presale<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_core::blast_domain::FeeAdmin>,
    fee_policy: &fee_policy::FeePolicy,
    raise_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
    token_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
    lp_fee_meme_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
    lp_fee_quote_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Locks the supplied `Coin<Quote>` in this presale under an equal-cap, open
/// eligibility policy and returns whatever a hard-capped uncapped phase could not
/// accept (a zero coin otherwise).
public fun commit_open<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut Presale<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    quote_in: Coin<Quote>,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): Coin<Quote>

/// Locks Quote from an allowlisted wallet after verifying its Merkle-committed cap,
/// returning whatever a hard cap could not accept.
public fun commit_allowlisted<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut Presale<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    quote_in: Coin<Quote>,
    index: u64,
    wallet_cap: u64,
    proof: vector<vector<u8>>,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): Coin<Quote>

/// Locks Quote from any wallet once an uncapped phase open to anyone has started,
/// returning whatever a hard cap could not accept.
public fun commit_uncapped<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut Presale<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    quote_in: Coin<Quote>,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): Coin<Quote>

/// Fixes the fill after the commitment window, or as soon as the raise is full under a hard cap
/// that closes the sale when filled; closing early ends the window now, so the LP deadline counts
/// from now. Underfunded sales become fully refundable. Anyone may settle.
public fun settle<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut Presale<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Cancels a funded presale still unmigrated at its LP deadline, preserving all
/// Quote for refunds. Anyone may cancel.
public fun cancel_unlaunched<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut Presale<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Delivers one participant's pro-rata tokens and overflow Quote after migration,
/// or its full Quote after cancellation. Under participant vesting, the tokens are
/// locked in a shared irrevocable linear schedule starting at this claim instead of
/// paid out; the Quote refund is always paid at once. Anyone may relay; the final
/// claim receives the bounded integer-rounding remainder.
public fun claim<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut Presale<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    participant: address,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Pays Blast's raise and token fees to `treasury` and the raise recipients their shares, and
/// releases every token recipient's tokens at once, locking each vesting share in its own shared
/// irrevocable schedule starting now, then returns the hand-off only the stored venue can redeem:
/// the rest of the raise, the LP-token allocation, and the vault's terms, with the sale's LP-fee
/// split, Blast's snapshotted LP-fee rates, its partner, and the migration residuals kept for the
/// owner. A sale naming a Blast partner holds Blast's fees in its ledger instead, for
/// `pay_protocol_fees_with_partner`. Anyone may call it until the sale is cancelled; an unredeemed
/// hand-off aborts the transaction, so the venue's pool creation stays atomic with this state
/// transition.
public fun migrate<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut Presale<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    treasury: &blast_core::blast_treasury::Treasury,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): blast_core::migration::Migration<SaleToken, Quote>

/// Proves to the sale's vault that the caller holds the sale's creator capability.
public fun prove_owner<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &Presale<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    cap: &PresaleCap,
): blast_core::owner_proof::OwnerProof

/// Pays a migrated sale's Blast partner its cut of each of Blast's fees the migration held, rounded
/// down so Blast keeps the remainder, and `treasury` the rest. The cut is the partner's
/// `blast_partners` applied rate. Anyone may call it: both recipients are fixed, and a ledger with
/// nothing held, before migration or once paid, sends nothing.
public fun pay_protocol_fees_with_partner<SaleToken, Quote>(
    self: &mut Presale<SaleToken, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    treasury: &blast_core::blast_treasury::Treasury,
    partner: &blast_partners::blast_partners::Partner,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Destroys the creator capability after cancellation. All minted SaleToken
/// allocations remain permanently locked in the cancelled presale.
public fun destroy_cap<SaleToken, Quote>(self: &Presale<SaleToken, Quote>, cap: PresaleCap)
```

#### Events

```move
/// A presale was created with fully funded token allocations.
public struct PresaleCreated<phantom SaleToken, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    presale_id: ID,
    presale_cap_id: ID,
    treasury_cap_id: ID,
    token_supply: u64,
    token_allocation_bps: u64,
    participant_vesting: Option<blast_core::payout::VestingTerms>,
    liquidity_token_allocation_bps: u64,
    /// Each token recipient, with the terms it vests under, if any, and its share.
    recipients: vector<blast_core::payout::Recipient>,
    recipient_bps: vector<u64>,
    burnable: bool,
    raise_target: u64,
    /// Each raise recipient, with the terms it vests under, if any, and its share.
    raise_recipients: vector<blast_core::payout::Recipient>,
    raise_recipient_bps: vector<u64>,
    duration_ms: u64,
    liquidity_window_ms: u64,
    eligibility: EligibilityPolicy,
    uncapped: Option<UncappedPhase>,
    hard_cap: Option<HardCap>,
    venue: TypeName,
    fee_split: blast_core::fee_split::FeeSplit,
    /// Blast's rates, snapshotted for this sale.
    protocol_raise_bps: u64,
    protocol_token_bps: u64,
    protocol_lp_fee_meme_bps: u64,
    protocol_lp_fee_quote_bps: u64,
    /// Blast's shares of the raise and of the supply, paid on migration.
    protocol_quote: u64,
    protocol_tokens: u64,
}
```

### `blast_presale::blast_presale_package`

The presale's publication and the one constructor of its package witness.  Publication hands the deployer an owned `Publication<BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>`, which `blast_admin::package_admin::wrap` turns into the shared `PackageAdmin<BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>` and the shared `PackageVersion<BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>`, fully paused. Pausing, upgrades, and immutability go through `blast_admin::package_admin` under the package-scoped roles `PauseAdmin<BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>`, `UpgradeAdmin<BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>`, and `CancelAdmin<BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>`.  The fee and creation policies start with zero delays so Blast configures them while the package is paused; `creation_policy::unpause` refuses until every delay is guarded, then clears bits with the package witness. It lives beside the policies it reads because they name `BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE`, so this module cannot import them.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/presale/sources/blast_presale_package.move

#### Types

```move
/// The package's one-time witness (OTW), typing its version, publication, and roles.
public struct BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE() has drop;

/// The presale's one package witness, pinned at publication. It seals each sale's protocol-fee
/// ledger, migration, vault terms and owner proofs, and clears pause bits through the generic
/// administration. Only this module constructs it, through the package-only `package_witness`;
/// nothing stores it or returns it outside the package.
public struct PackageWitness() has drop;
```

### `blast_presale::constants`

Package-wide presale constants exposed as zero-cost macros. The basis-points denominator and Blast's LP-fee share maximum come from `blast_core::constants`.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/presale/sources/lib/constants.move

#### Constants

- `version: u64 = 1`: The package version this bytecode serves.
- `create_pause_bit: u8 = 1`: Stops presale creation and sharing.
- `commit_pause_bit: u8 = 2`: Stops open, allowlisted, and uncapped commitments.
- `migration_pause_bit: u8 = 4`: Stops LP migration.
- `valid_pause_bits: u8 = blast_presale::constants::create_pause_bit!() | blast_presale::constants::commit_pause_bit!() | blast_presale::constants::migration_pause_bit!()`: Every supported presale pause flag.
- `max_participants: u64 = 65_536`: Technical bound on the dynamic commitment records one presale may hold.
- `max_recipients: u64 = 64`: Bounds the token and raise recipient lists, both paid in the one migration transaction.
- `min_liquidity_window_duration_ms: u64 = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1_000`: The shortest LP-migration window. Migration is permissionless, so a funded sale reaches its refund exit only after a week in which nobody migrated it, and a sale that nobody settled by its end cannot be settled and cancelled in one transaction inside that week.
- `max_raise_bps: u64 = 1_000`: Blast's largest share of a sale's raise.
- `max_token_bps: u64 = 1_000`: Blast's largest share of a sale's tokens.
- `digest_length: u64 = 32`: Byte length of a Blake2b-256 digest: an allowlist's Merkle root.
- `allowlist_leaf_domain: vector<u8> = b"blast-presale-v1"`: The Merkle leaf domain of every presale allowlist, `blast_core::merkle::leaf`'s domain for each `(index, wallet, wallet_cap)` payload.

### `blast_presale::creation_policy`

Blast's allowlists for new presales: the Quote coins a sale may raise, the venues whose tickets may start a sale, and the Blast partners a sale may name; and the presale's `unpause`, which reads these and the fee policy's delays.  A presale is checked once, when it is created. Later changes apply only to later sales, so a delisting never strands a live sale's commitments, blocks its migration, or stops paying its partner.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/presale/sources/config/creation_policy.move

#### Types

```move
/// Shared singleton holding the Quote types, venues, and partners new presales may use.
public struct CreationPolicy has key {
    id: UID,
    allowed_quotes: VecSet<TypeName>,
    venues: blast_admin::delayed_set::DelayedSet<VenueKey, TypeName>,
    partners: blast_partners::partner_list::PartnerList,
}

/// Keys the delayed lifecycle of venue admissions and their delay.
public struct VenueKey() has copy, drop, store;
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Allows or disallows `Quote` for presales created afterward; existing ones keep it.
public fun set_quote_allowed<Quote>(
    self: &mut CreationPolicy,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_core::blast_domain::ListingAdmin>,
    allowed: bool,
)

/// Admits a venue's witness type after the applied admission delay. An admitted venue's tickets
/// start presales afterward, and only that venue redeems their migrations; existing sales keep
/// their venue. Rescheduling a pending admission restarts its delay.
///
/// `presale::new` and `presale::migrate` are public, so whoever can construct an admitted witness
/// can open sales and redeem their liquidity. Admit only a struct whose defining module is the
/// reviewed venue and keeps its constructor private. A primitive, a vector, or a framework type,
/// any of which a caller can construct, is rejected.
public fun schedule_venue<Venue: drop>(
    self: &mut CreationPolicy,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_core::blast_domain::VenueAdmin>,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Permissionlessly applies the approved admission once ready.
public fun apply_venue<Venue: drop>(
    self: &mut CreationPolicy,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Cancels a pending venue admission, including after its threshold.
public fun cancel_venue<Venue: drop>(
    self: &mut CreationPolicy,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_core::blast_domain::CancelAdmin>,
)

/// Immediately removes a venue for new presales and cancels any pending admission.
public fun remove_venue<Venue: drop>(
    self: &mut CreationPolicy,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_core::blast_domain::VenueAdmin>,
)

/// Lets new presales name `partner`, at once. Adding a partner whose removal is pending cancels
/// the removal; adding a removed partner accepts it again.
public fun add_partner(
    self: &mut CreationPolicy,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_core::blast_domain::FeeAdmin>,
    partner: &blast_partners::blast_partners::Partner,
)

/// Stops new presales naming `partner` after the delay Blast gives for every change to a
/// partner, `blast_partners::delay_ms()`. Sales that already name it keep paying it.
public fun remove_partner(
    self: &mut CreationPolicy,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_core::blast_domain::FeeAdmin>,
    partner: &blast_partners::blast_partners::Partner,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Proposes only the admission delay. Existing admission deadlines remain fixed.
public fun schedule_venue_delay(
    self: &mut CreationPolicy,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_core::blast_domain::VenueAdmin>,
    delay_ms: u64,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Permissionlessly applies a ready admission-delay proposal.
public fun apply_venue_delay(
    self: &mut CreationPolicy,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Cancels only the admission-delay proposal.
public fun cancel_venue_delay(
    self: &mut CreationPolicy,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_core::blast_domain::CancelAdmin>,
)

/// Clears the requested pause bits once every presale delay and the core treasury's delay are
/// guarded: nonzero, with no pending change that would set one to zero and no pending admission.
/// A delay left at its zero publication value therefore blocks release instead of going live; the
/// generic administration then checks the upgrade delay and the pinned witness. Settlement,
/// cancellation, refunds and claims never require unpausing.
public fun unpause(
    self: &CreationPolicy,
    package_version: &mut blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    unpause_admin: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_admin::package_admin::UnpauseAdmin<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>>,
    package_admin: &blast_admin::package_admin::PackageAdmin<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    fee_policy: &fee_policy::FeePolicy,
    treasury: &blast_core::blast_treasury::Treasury,
    bits: u8,
)
```

### `blast_presale::events`

Presale event payloads and their package-only emitters. Pauses and versions emit from `blast_admin`, delayed settings from its delayed modules, partner acceptance from `blast_partners::partner_list`, and Blast's fee payments from `blast_core`. `PresaleCreated` stays beside the sale terms it records in `blast_presale`, which would otherwise form a module cycle.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/presale/sources/lib/events.move

#### Events

```move
/// Presales created afterward may (`allowed`) or may not raise `Quote`.
public struct QuoteAllowed<phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    allowed: bool,
}

/// A presale was shared with these commitment and liquidity windows and its Blast partner, if
/// any. Commitments open at `start_ms`, which may be later than the share. A sale whose hard cap
/// closes it when filled may end earlier; `PresaleFunded` records when it did.
public struct PresaleOpened<phantom SaleToken, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    presale_id: ID,
    start_ms: u64,
    end_ms: u64,
    liquidity_deadline_ms: u64,
    uncapped_from_ms: u64,
    hard_cap_from_ms: Option<u64>,
    partner_id: Option<ID>,
}

/// Before the window started, Blast's `FeeAdmin` replaced this sale's Blast rates, moving Blast's
/// tokens to or from the sale allocation and its Quote to or from the LP's.
public struct ProtocolFeesChanged<phantom SaleToken, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    presale_id: ID,
    protocol_raise_bps: u64,
    protocol_token_bps: u64,
    protocol_lp_fee_meme_bps: u64,
    protocol_lp_fee_quote_bps: u64,
    /// Blast's shares of the raise and of the supply, paid on migration.
    protocol_quote: u64,
    protocol_tokens: u64,
    /// The tokens buyers now share pro rata.
    token_allocation: u64,
}

/// Quote joined a presale from the transaction sender.
public struct Committed<phantom SaleToken, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    presale_id: ID,
    quote: u64,
    wallet_commitment: u64,
    total_commitments: u64,
    participants: u64,
}

/// A funded presale closed at `end_ms` with these fixed claim totals; anyone may cancel it once
/// it is still unmigrated at `liquidity_deadline_ms`. Both are earlier than `PresaleOpened`'s
/// when the sale closed early.
public struct PresaleFunded<phantom SaleToken, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    presale_id: ID,
    total_commitments: u64,
    accepted_quote: u64,
    refundable_quote: u64,
    token_allocation: u64,
    end_ms: u64,
    liquidity_deadline_ms: u64,
}

/// A presale became fully refundable without releasing Quote.
public struct PresaleCancelled<phantom SaleToken, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    presale_id: ID,
    total_commitments: u64,
    refundable_quote: u64,
}

/// The raise left after Blast's and the recipients' shares, and the LP-token allocation, left
/// the sale in its hand-off to `venue`.
public struct PresaleMigrated<phantom SaleToken, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    presale_id: ID,
    venue: TypeName,
    liquidity_quote: u64,
    liquidity_tokens: u64,
    recipient_tokens: u64,
}

/// One configured recipient received its share of the raise, or the vesting schedule
/// `vesting_id` that holds it.
public struct RaiseAllocated<phantom SaleToken, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    presale_id: ID,
    recipient: address,
    quote: u64,
    vesting_id: Option<ID>,
}

/// One configured recipient received its immutable token allocation, or the vesting schedule
/// `vesting_id` that holds it.
public struct RecipientAllocated<phantom SaleToken, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    presale_id: ID,
    recipient: address,
    tokens: u64,
    vesting_id: Option<ID>,
}

/// `participant` received its token allocation, or the vesting schedule `vesting_id` that holds
/// it, and its Quote refund, leaving `remaining_participants` wallets still to claim.
public struct Claimed<phantom SaleToken, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    presale_id: ID,
    participant: address,
    wallet_commitment: u64,
    tokens: u64,
    quote_refund: u64,
    remaining_participants: u64,
    vesting_id: Option<ID>,
}
```

### `blast_presale::fee_policy`

Blast's fees on presales: a share of every successful raise, of every token supply, and of every collected LP fee.  Each presale snapshots the rates when it is created. Until the sale's window starts, the `FeeAdmin` may change that sale's rates, so its economics are fixed before commitments open; the LP-fee rates then pass to the sale's vault in its migration terms, which changes them per vault after delay. Blast's fees are paid to the one `blast_core::blast_treasury::Treasury`.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/presale/sources/config/fee_policy.move

#### Types

```move
/// Shared singleton holding the rates new presales snapshot.
public struct FeePolicy has key {
    id: UID,
    fees: blast_admin::delayed::Delayed<FeesKey, ProtocolFees>,
}

/// Keys the delayed lifecycle of the rates new presales snapshot.
public struct FeesKey() has copy, drop, store;

/// Blast's rates, in BPS: of the accepted raise, of the token supply, and of each collected
/// LP-fee asset.
public struct ProtocolFees has copy, drop, store {
    raise_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
    token_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
    lp_fee_meme_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
    lp_fee_quote_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
}
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Sets the rates presales created afterward snapshot; existing presales keep theirs.
/// Schedules fees after the full administrative delay.
public fun schedule_fees(
    self: &mut FeePolicy,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_core::blast_domain::FeeAdmin>,
    raise_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
    token_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
    lp_fee_meme_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
    lp_fee_quote_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
    delay_ms: u64,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Applies the scheduled fees permissionlessly once ready.
public fun apply_fees(
    self: &mut FeePolicy,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Cancels a pending change, including after its delay has elapsed.
public fun cancel_fees(
    self: &mut FeePolicy,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_presale_package::BLAST_PRESALE_PACKAGE>,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_core::blast_domain::CancelAdmin>,
)
```

## API reference: `blast_fun` (Launchpad)

Not yet published on mainnet. Its interface may change before publication.

Events: payload structs are emitted directly, each under its own type.

Abort codes: this package aborts with the numeric codes below from whichever module detects the failure; the abort location names that module.

| Code | Constant | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | `EInvalidTradeFeeBps` | A trade fee is above the launch configuration's ceiling. |
| 1 | `EDecimalsNotAllowed` | The Meme decimals are not admitted for new launches. |
| 2 | `EVenueNotAllowed` | The venue is not admitted for new launches. |
| 3 | `EInvalidVenue` | A primitive or framework type cannot be a venue. |
| 4 | `EInvalidProtocolAllocation` | Blast's allocation exceeds its 1,000 bps maximum for either asset. |
| 5 | `EInvalidShares` | The shares do not sum to 10,000, or the curve or pool Meme share is zero. |
| 6 | `ERecipientCapacityReached` | A split has more than sixteen recipients. |
| 7 | `EInvalidSellBurnBps` | The sell-burn rate is above its ceiling. |
| 8 | `EInvalidInitialMemeSupply` | The ticket's supply is not the canonical one billion tokens. |
| 9 | `EInvalidMemeQuotePair` | Meme and Quote are the same type. |
| 10 | `EInvalidOpeningRound` | The opening round is neither zero nor within its bounds. |
| 11 | `EInvalidGraduationTarget` | The pool's Quote share of the graduation target rounds to zero. |
| 12 | `EInvalidLaunchLifecycle` | The launch is not in the state this operation needs. |
| 13 | `ESlippageExceeded` | The output is below the caller's minimum. |
| 14 | `EZeroTradeOutput` | The trade's net output is zero. |
| 15 | `EOpeningRoundEnded` | The opening round has ended. |
| 16 | `EOpeningRoundNotEnded` | The opening round has not ended, or the launch is not shared yet. |
| 17 | `ENothingAccrued` | There are no fees to claim. |
| 18 | `ECreatorCapNotLive` | The creator cap is not the one the launch honors. |
| 19 | `EUnchanged` | A setter was called with the value already in place. |
| 20 | `EInvalidCreatorRecipient` | The creator recipient address is zero. |
| 21 | `EInvalidAccountCommitment` | The account commitment is not 32 bytes. |
| 22 | `EInvalidCreatorClaimPublicKey` | The claim signer key is neither empty nor 32 bytes. |
| 23 | `EInvalidCreatorClaimAttestation` | The claim attestation is unexpected or malformed. |
| 24 | `ECreatorClaimExpired` | The claim attestation has expired. |
| 25 | `ECreatorNotSender` | The sender is not the creator recipient. |
| 26 | `EInvalidCreatorClaimSignature` | The claim attestation's signature does not verify. |
| 27 | `EQuoteNotAllowed` | The Quote is not admitted for new launches. |
| 28 | `EInvalidVirtualQuote` | The virtual Quote reserve is zero, which would let the first purchase take the whole curve. |
| 29 | `EZeroOpeningRoundBid` | An opening-round bid is zero. |
| 30 | `EInvalidCreationFee` | The creation fee paid is not exactly the configured one, or a configured fee exceeds 10 SUI. |
| 31 | `ETooManyClaimSigners` | The account-claim signer set already holds its most live and pending keys. |
| 32 | `EUnguardedDelay` | Unpausing needs every policy delay nonzero, with no pending zero delay or admission. |
| 33 | `EInvalidProtocolFeeShare` | Blast's share of the trade fee exceeds its 7,000 bps maximum. |
| 34 | `EInvalidLpFeeBps` | Blast's LP-fee share exceeds its 3,000 bps maximum for either asset. |

### `blast_fun::allocation`

Migration allocation plans and their exact apportionment.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/launchpad/sources/math/allocation.move

```move
/// One recipient at migration, paid outright or vested, with its shares of the Meme supply and
/// the final Quote reserve.
public struct RecipientShare has copy, drop, store {
    recipient: blast_core::payout::Recipient,
    meme_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
    quote_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
}

/// How migration divides the Meme supply and the final Quote reserve between the curve, the pool,
/// and the recipients. Each asset sums to 10,000 once Blast's allocation is added.

    lp_meme_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
    lp_quote_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
    protocol_meme_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
    protocol_quote_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
    recipients: vector<RecipientShare>,

    meme_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
    quote_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
}
```

```move
/// A plan share: `recipient` (`blast_core::payout::recipient`, which rejects the zero address)
/// receives `meme_bps` of the Meme supply and `quote_bps` of the final Quote reserve at migration.
public fun recipient_share(
    recipient: blast_core::payout::Recipient,
    meme_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
    quote_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,

/// The curve needs positive Meme and the pool needs positive Meme and Quote shares.
/// Blast's allocation is added at finalization.

    lp_quote_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,

): AllocationPlan
```

### `blast_fun::blast_fun`

The launchpad's publication and its package witness.  Publication hands the deployer an owned `Publication<BLAST_FUN>`, which `blast_admin::package_admin::wrap` turns into the shared `PackageAdmin<BLAST_FUN>` and the shared `PackageVersion<BLAST_FUN>`, fully paused. Pausing, upgrades, and immutability go through `blast_admin::package_admin` under the package-scoped roles `PauseAdmin<BLAST_FUN>`, `UpgradeAdmin<BLAST_FUN>`, and `CancelAdmin<BLAST_FUN>`.  The publication pins `PackageWitness`, the one witness the package passes wherever a sealed call must name the launchpad: the launch fee ledger, migration hand-off, vault terms and owner proofs, and the generic administration's pause release. `launch_config::unpause` releases pause bits once every launchpad delay is guarded; it lives beside the configurations it reads, which name `BLAST_FUN`, so this module cannot import them.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/launchpad/sources/blast_fun.move

#### Types

```move
/// The package's one-time witness (OTW), typing its version, publication, and roles.
public struct BLAST_FUN() has drop;

/// The launchpad's package witness. Only this package constructs it, through `package_witness`;
/// every caller passes it straight into the sealing or release call, and no function stores it or
/// returns it outside this package.
public struct PackageWitness() has drop;
```

### `blast_fun::constants`

Package-wide protocol constants exposed as zero-cost macros.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/launchpad/sources/lib/constants.move

#### Constants

- `version: u64 = 1`: The package version this bytecode serves.
- `create_pause_bit: u8 = 1`: Stops launch creation, finalization, and sharing.
- `trading_pause_bit: u8 = 2`: Stops buying, selling, and opening-round entry and settlement.
- `migration_pause_bit: u8 = 4`: Stops voluntary launch migration.
- `valid_pause_bits: u8 = blast_fun::constants::create_pause_bit!() | blast_fun::constants::trading_pause_bit!() | blast_fun::constants::migration_pause_bit!()`: Every supported launchpad pause flag.
- `max_recipients: u64 = 16`: Maximum recipients in an allocation plan.
- `max_trade_fee_bps: u64 = 1_000`: Maximum LaunchConfig trade-fee rate for either the meme or quote asset.
- `max_protocol_allocation_bps: u64 = 1_000`: Maximum Blast allocation of a launch's Meme supply or final Quote reserve, each asset.
- `max_protocol_fee_share_bps: u64 = 7_000`: Maximum Blast share of each launch trade fee; the creator receives the rest.
- `max_creation_fee_mist: u64 = 10_000_000_000`: Maximum creation fee, in MIST (10 SUI).
- `max_sell_burn_bps: u64 = 5_000`: Maximum creator-selected share of post-fee Meme sell input reserved for burn.
- `min_opening_round_ms: u64 = 60_000`: Shortest opening round a creator may choose.
- `max_opening_round_ms: u64 = 300_000`: Longest opening round a creator may choose.
- `meme_total_supply_whole_tokens: u64 = 1_000_000_000`: Exact whole-token supply minted for every generated Meme currency.
- `max_claim_signers: u64 = 4`: Most account-claim signer keys live or pending at once: two live during a rotation, two staged.
- `ed25519_public_key_length: u64 = 32`: Canonical Ed25519 public-key length.
- `account_commitment_length: u64 = 32`: Byte length of an opaque Blast account commitment.

### `blast_fun::creator_authority`

Creator recipients, the one-time claim they authorize, and the revocable caps it issues.

#### Types

```move
/// Who may claim a launch's creator caps: an address, or a Blast account the backend attests.
```

```move
public fun new_account(account_commitment: vector<u8>): CreatorRecipient

/// administrator reassigns the cap.

public fun destroy_creator_metadata_cap<Meme>(self: CreatorMetadataCap<Meme>)
```

#### Constants

- `CREATOR_CLAIM_DOMAIN: vector<u8> = b"blast_fun::creator_claim::v1"`: Prefixes every signed account-claim message, so the backend key's signature over a claim cannot verify as another message of the same BCS shape.

### `blast_fun::events`

Launchpad event payloads and their package-only emitters. Pauses and versions emit from `blast_admin`, delayed settings from its delayed modules, and Blast's fee payments from `blast_core`.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/launchpad/sources/lib/events.move

#### Events

```move
public struct MemeDecimalsAllowed has copy, drop {
    decimals: u8,
    allowed: bool,
}

/// A Quote type was admitted to (`allowed = true`) or removed from (`allowed = false`) future
/// launches. Existing launches keep trading in it.
public struct QuoteAllowed<phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    allowed: bool,
}

public struct CreatorCapsClaimed<phantom Meme, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    curve_fee_cap_id: ID,
    creator_metadata_cap_id: ID,
}

public struct CurveFeeCapReassigned<phantom Meme, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    curve_fee_cap_id: ID,
    recipient: address,
}

public struct CreatorMetadataCapReassigned<phantom Meme, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    creator_metadata_cap_id: ID,
    recipient: address,
}

public struct MemeMetadataUpdated<phantom Meme, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    name: String,
    description: String,
    icon_url: String,
}

/// A generated package created its currency and launch ticket. The supply is one billion whole
/// tokens at `decimals`.
public struct LaunchTicketCreated<phantom Meme> has copy, drop {
    ticket_id: ID,
    decimals: u8,
    metadata_cap_id: ID,
    creator: creator_authority::CreatorRecipient,
    burnable: bool,
    sell_burn_bps: u64,
}

/// A launch was created from `ticket_id` with these settings; a zero `opening_round_ms` has no
/// opening round. The creator paid `creation_fee` SUI, held with Blast's fees on the launch;
/// `partner_id` is the launch's partner for good, if it names one.
public struct LaunchCreated<phantom Meme, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    ticket_id: ID,
    venue: TypeName,
    lp_fee_split: blast_core::fee_split::FeeSplit,
    virtual_quote: u64,
    graduation_target: u64,
    quote_fee_bps: u64,
    meme_fee_bps: u64,
    allocation_plan: allocation::AllocationPlan,
    opening_round_ms: u64,
    creation_fee: u64,
    partner_id: Option<ID>,
}

public struct LaunchShared<phantom Meme, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    public_start_ms: u64,
}

/// `quote_amount` joined a launch's opening round from the sender; `bids` is the pot after it.
public struct OpeningRoundJoined<phantom Meme, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    quote_amount: u64,
    bids: u64,
}

/// The opening round closed: its `bids` bought `meme_amount` from the curve, in the same
/// transaction's `Bought` when there is one, and left `quote_amount` to refund. Both are delivered
/// pro rata.
public struct OpeningRoundSettled<phantom Meme, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    bids: u64,
    meme_amount: u64,
    quote_amount: u64,
}

/// `bidder`'s share of the opening round, for its `bid`, was sent to it.
public struct OpeningRoundDelivered<phantom Meme, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    bidder: address,
    bid: u64,
    meme_amount: u64,
    quote_amount: u64,
}

/// A curve purchase; reserves are after the purchase. Purchases before `LaunchShared` are the
/// creator's, made in the transaction that creates the launch; the one beside
/// `OpeningRoundSettled` is the opening round's pot.
public struct Bought<phantom Meme, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    quote_in: u64,
    meme_out_gross: u64,
    meme_out_net: u64,
    quote_refund: u64,
    protocol_meme_fee: u64,
    creator_meme_fee: u64,
    protocol_quote_fee: u64,
    creator_quote_fee: u64,
    meme_reserve: u64,
    real_quote_reserve: u64,
}

/// A curve sale; reserves are after the sale.
public struct Sold<phantom Meme, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    meme_in_gross: u64,
    pending_burn: u64,
    quote_out_gross: u64,
    protocol_meme_fee: u64,
    creator_meme_fee: u64,
    protocol_quote_fee: u64,
    creator_quote_fee: u64,
    meme_reserve: u64,
    real_quote_reserve: u64,
}

/// One recipient's allocation, paid when migration begins: as coins to `destination`, or into the
/// vesting schedules named here when the recipient vests.
public struct MigrationAllocationPaid<phantom Meme, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    destination: address,
    meme_amount: u64,
    quote_amount: u64,
    meme_vesting_id: Option<ID>,
    quote_vesting_id: Option<ID>,
}

/// Migration committed: the adapter received `meme_amount` and `quote_amount` for the pool, and
/// `disposed_meme` was burned (or sent to `@0x0` under a fixed supply).
public struct Migrated<phantom Meme, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    meme_amount: u64,
    quote_amount: u64,
    disposed_meme: u64,
    total_supply_after: u64,
}

public struct CreatorFeesClaimed<phantom Meme, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    meme_amount: u64,
    quote_amount: u64,
}

/// Blast's one-time migration Meme and Quote fee joined the launch's protocol ledger.
public struct ProtocolFeesAccrued<phantom Meme, phantom Quote> has copy, drop {
    launch_id: ID,
    meme_amount: u64,
    quote_amount: u64,
}
```

### `blast_fun::launch`

Launch construction, the bonding curve, the migration hand-off, and the owner proof.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/launchpad/sources/launch/launch.move

#### Types

```move
/// Shared singleton every launch's object ID derives from, so a client finds a coin's one launch
/// from the coin type alone.
public struct LaunchRegistry has key {
    id: UID,
}

/// Derives the one launch of `Meme` from the registry.
public struct LaunchKey<phantom Meme>() has copy, drop, store;

public enum Lifecycle has copy, drop, store {
    OpeningRound,
    Live,
    MigrationReady,
    Migrated,
}

/// Dynamic-field name of one bidder's undelivered opening-round Quote.
public struct OpeningRoundBidKey(address) has copy, drop, store;

/// One launch: its curve, its settings, and custody until migration.
///
/// A launch with an opening round starts in `OpeningRound`. Until `opening_round_ms` after share,
/// Quote joins one pot and nothing trades; settling buys from the curve once with the whole pot, and
/// each bidder is delivered its pro-rata share of the Meme bought and of any Quote refunded.
public struct Launch<phantom Meme, phantom Quote> has key {
    id: UID,
    lifecycle: Lifecycle,
    public_start_ms: Option<u64>,
    opening_round_ms: u64,
    /// Total Quote of the opening-round bids not yet delivered.
    opening_round_bids: u64,
    /// The pot until settlement, then the Quote it left to refund.
    opening_round_quote: Balance<Quote>,
    opening_round_meme: Balance<Meme>,
    sell_burn_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
    virtual_quote: u64,
    graduation_target: u64,
    quote_fee_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
    meme_fee_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
    /// The venue witness type the launch's liquidity migrates to.
    venue: TypeName,
    lp_fee_split: blast_core::fee_split::FeeSplit,
    atomic_supply: u64,
    meme_reserve: Balance<Meme>,
    real_quote_reserve: Balance<Quote>,
    pending_burn: Balance<Meme>,
    allocation_plan: allocation::AllocationPlan,
    allocated_meme: Balance<Meme>,
    /// Blast's fees: its trade-fee share, the creation fee, and the one-time migration fee.
    protocol_fees: blast_core::protocol_fees::Ledger<Meme, Quote>,
    /// The creator's trade-fee share, claimed with the curve-fee cap.
    creator_meme_fees: Balance<Meme>,
    creator_quote_fees: Balance<Quote>,
    metadata_cap: MetadataCap<Meme>,
    curve_fee_cap_reassignment: blast_admin::delayed_action::DelayedAction<CurveFeeCapReassignment, address>,
    creator_metadata_cap_reassignment: blast_admin::delayed_action::DelayedAction<CreatorMetadataCapReassignment, address>,
    creator: Option<creator_authority::CreatorRecipient>,
    curve_fee_cap_id: Option<ID>,
    creator_metadata_cap_id: Option<ID>,
    /// The Blast partner named at creation, paid its share of every fee Blast takes on this
    /// launch. It never changes.
    partner_id: Option<ID>,
}

/// Keys the curve-fee cap reassignment's delayed lifecycle; its action is the recipient.
public struct CurveFeeCapReassignment() has copy, drop, store;

/// Keys the metadata cap reassignment's delayed lifecycle; its action is the recipient.
public struct CreatorMetadataCapReassignment() has copy, drop, store;

/// Hot potato from `new` to `finalize`, collecting the creator's settings.
public struct LaunchInitializer<phantom Meme, phantom Quote> {
    ticket: launch_ticket::LaunchTicket<Meme>,
    treasury_cap: TreasuryCap<Meme>,
    venue: TypeName,
    quote_fee_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
    meme_fee_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
    virtual_quote: Option<u64>,
    graduation_target: Option<u64>,
    allocation_plan: Option<allocation::AllocationPlan>,
    lp_fee_split: Option<blast_core::fee_split::FeeSplit>,
    opening_round_ms: u64,
    partner_id: Option<ID>,
}
```

#### Functions

```move
/// Starts a launch whose liquidity migrates to the venue that issued `venue_ticket` after
/// preparing the coin with `treasury_cap`. The Quote, the venue, and the decimals must be admitted.
public fun new<Meme, Quote>(
    ticket: launch_ticket::LaunchTicket<Meme>,
    treasury_cap: TreasuryCap<Meme>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    config: &launch_config::LaunchConfig,
    venue_ticket: blast_core::migration::VenueTicket<Meme, Quote>,
): LaunchInitializer<Meme, Quote>

/// Sets the virtual Quote reserve the curve starts from, which prices the first purchase.
public fun set_virtual_quote<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut LaunchInitializer<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    virtual_quote: u64,
)

/// Sets the Quote reserve at which the curve closes.
public fun set_graduation_target<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut LaunchInitializer<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    graduation_target: u64,
)

public fun set_allocation_plan<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut LaunchInitializer<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    allocation_plan: allocation::AllocationPlan,
)

public fun set_lp_fee_split<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut LaunchInitializer<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    lp_fee_split: blast_core::fee_split::FeeSplit,
)

/// Sets how long the opening round runs after share, within the protocol's bounds. Zero, the
/// default, has no opening round: trading starts at share.
public fun set_opening_round<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut LaunchInitializer<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    opening_round_duration_ms: u64,
)

/// Names the launch's Blast partner, one new launches may name. From `finalize` on it is the
/// launch's partner for good, paid its share of every fee Blast takes on the launch when Blast
/// claims them.
public fun set_partner<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut LaunchInitializer<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    config: &launch_config::LaunchConfig,
    partner: &blast_partners::blast_partners::Partner,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Checks every setting, adds Blast's allocation to the plan, fixes the canonical supply in the
/// Coin Registry, and splits the Meme into the curve reserve and the migration allocations.
/// `creation_fee` must be exactly the configured fee; it joins Blast's fees on the launch. The
/// version check also rejects stale finalization in a transaction that used current intake. The
/// launch's ID derives from `registry` and the coin type.
public fun finalize<Meme, Quote>(
    self: LaunchInitializer<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    registry: &mut LaunchRegistry,
    currency: &mut Currency<Meme>,
    config: &launch_config::LaunchConfig,
    creation_fee: Coin<sui::SUI>,
): Launch<Meme, Quote>

/// Shares the launch. Public time starts now: trading, or the opening round, which ends
/// `opening_round_ms` later.
public fun share<Meme, Quote>(
    self: Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Authenticates the creator recipient and issues both creator capabilities.
public fun claim_creator_caps<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    config: &runtime_config::RuntimeConfig,
    account_attestation: Option<vector<u8>>,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): (creator_authority::CurveFeeCap<Meme>, creator_authority::CreatorMetadataCap<Meme>)

/// Changes only this launch's curve-fee cap delay, after its applied delay.
/// Apply through `apply_curve_fee_cap_delay`; replaces any pending reassignment.
public fun schedule_curve_fee_cap_delay<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_core::blast_domain::CreatorAdmin>,
    delay_ms: u64,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Announces a replacement recipient without invalidating the current curve-fee cap, after
/// the applied delay. Unclaimed curve fees follow the fresh cap when applied.
public fun schedule_curve_fee_cap_reassignment<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_core::blast_domain::CreatorAdmin>,
    recipient: address,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Cancels the pending reassignment or delay change without affecting either live creator cap.
public fun cancel_curve_fee_cap_reassignment<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_core::blast_domain::CancelAdmin>,
)

/// Permissionlessly applies a ready curve-fee cap delay change.
public fun apply_curve_fee_cap_delay<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Permissionlessly applies a ready reassignment: issues a fresh curve-fee cap to the
/// recipient and retires the old authority.
public fun apply_curve_fee_cap_reassignment<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Changes only this launch's metadata cap delay, after its applied delay.
/// Apply through `apply_creator_metadata_cap_delay`; replaces any pending reassignment.
public fun schedule_creator_metadata_cap_delay<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_core::blast_domain::CreatorAdmin>,
    delay_ms: u64,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Announces a replacement recipient without invalidating the current metadata cap, after
/// the applied delay.
public fun schedule_creator_metadata_cap_reassignment<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_core::blast_domain::CreatorAdmin>,
    recipient: address,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Cancels the pending reassignment or delay change without affecting either live creator cap.
public fun cancel_creator_metadata_cap_reassignment<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_core::blast_domain::CancelAdmin>,
)

/// Permissionlessly applies a ready metadata cap delay change.
public fun apply_creator_metadata_cap_delay<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Permissionlessly applies a ready reassignment: issues a fresh metadata cap to the
/// recipient and retires the old authority.
public fun apply_creator_metadata_cap_reassignment<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

public fun set_name<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    creator_metadata_cap: &creator_authority::CreatorMetadataCap<Meme>,
    currency: &mut Currency<Meme>,
    name: String,
)

public fun set_description<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    creator_metadata_cap: &creator_authority::CreatorMetadataCap<Meme>,
    currency: &mut Currency<Meme>,
    description: String,
)

public fun set_icon_url<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    creator_metadata_cap: &creator_authority::CreatorMetadataCap<Meme>,
    currency: &mut Currency<Meme>,
    icon_url: String,
)

/// Adds `quote_in` to the sender's opening-round bid. Before share only the creator's own
/// transaction can reach the launch, so the creator's bid joins the same pot at the same price.
public fun join_opening_round<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    quote_in: Coin<Quote>,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Closes the ended opening round: buys from the curve once with the whole pot, at the usual fees
/// and graduation cap, and holds the Meme bought and any Quote refunded for delivery. A pot too
/// small to buy one Meme atom is held whole for refund unless it reaches graduation. Anyone may settle.
public fun settle_opening_round<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    runtime_config: &runtime_config::RuntimeConfig,
    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Sends `bidder` its share of the settled opening round: the Meme bought and the Quote refunded,
/// pro rata to its bid among the undelivered bids and rounded down, so the last delivery takes the
/// remainder. Anyone may deliver, in any later lifecycle.
public fun deliver_opening_round<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    bidder: address,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Buys Meme with Quote; Quote beyond the graduation target is refunded. Trading opens at share,
/// or at settlement after an opening round; before share only the creator's transaction can buy.
/// A target-reaching buy may return zero Meme when `min_meme_out` is zero.
public fun buy<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    runtime_config: &runtime_config::RuntimeConfig,
    quote_in: Coin<Quote>,
    min_meme_out: u64,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): (Coin<Meme>, Coin<Quote>)

/// Sells Meme for Quote; the sell-burn share of the input waits in `pending_burn`.
public fun sell<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    runtime_config: &runtime_config::RuntimeConfig,
    meme_in: Coin<Meme>,
    min_quote_out: u64,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): Coin<Quote>

public fun claim_creator_fees<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    curve_fee_cap: &creator_authority::CurveFeeCap<Meme>,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): (Coin<Meme>, Coin<Quote>)

/// Pays `treasury` Blast's fees on a launch that names no partner: its trade fees, the creation
/// fee, and the one-time migration fee. Anyone may claim; an empty ledger pays nothing.
public fun claim_protocol_fees<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    treasury: &blast_core::blast_treasury::Treasury,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Pays Blast's fees on a launch that names `partner`: the partner its share of each, then
/// `treasury` the rest, in the same call. Anyone may claim; an empty ledger pays nothing.
public fun claim_protocol_fees_with_partner<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    treasury: &blast_core::blast_treasury::Treasury,
    partner: &blast_partners::blast_partners::Partner,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
)

/// Pays every project recipient, outright or into its vesting schedule starting now, accrues
/// Blast's one-time Meme and Quote fee in the launch ledger, burns the curve's unsold Meme and
/// pending sell-burn (or sends them to `@0x0` when the supply is fixed), and returns the hand-off
/// only the stored venue can redeem: the pool's share and the vault's terms, with Blast's applied
/// LP-fee share and the migration residuals paid to Blast.
/// Anyone may call it; an unredeemed hand-off aborts the transaction.
public fun migrate<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &mut Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    config: &launch_config::LaunchConfig,
    currency: &mut Currency<Meme>,
    clock: &Clock,
    ctx: &mut TxContext,
): blast_core::migration::Migration<Meme, Quote>

/// Proves to the launch's vault that the caller holds the curve-fee cap this launch honors.
public fun prove_owner<Meme, Quote>(
    self: &Launch<Meme, Quote>,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    curve_fee_cap: &creator_authority::CurveFeeCap<Meme>,
): blast_core::owner_proof::OwnerProof
```

#### Constants

- `DEFAULT_CAP_REASSIGNMENT_DELAY_MS: u64 = 48 * 60 * 60 * 1_000`: Initial delay for each creator-cap reassignment: 48 hours in milliseconds.

### `blast_fun::launch_config`

Launch policy each new launch snapshots.

Source: https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-contracts/blob/main/sui/launchpad/sources/config/launch_config.move

#### Types

```move
/// The two trade rates change atomically.
public struct TradeFees has copy, drop, store {
    quote_fee_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
    meme_fee_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
}

/// Admitted decimals, Quotes, and venues; the trade fees; Blast's one-time migration allocation;
/// Blast's share of each new vault's LP fees; the SUI every launch pays at creation; and the Blast
/// partners new launches may name. Each creator picks the virtual Quote reserve their curve
/// starts from.
public struct LaunchConfig has key {
    id: UID,
    meme_decimals: VecSet<u8>,
    quotes: VecSet<TypeName>,
    trade_fees: blast_admin::delayed::Delayed<TradeFeesKey, TradeFees>,
    venues: blast_admin::delayed_set::DelayedSet<VenueKey, TypeName>,
    protocol_allocation: blast_admin::delayed::Delayed<ProtocolAllocationKey, allocation::ProtocolAllocation>,
    protocol_lp_fees: blast_admin::delayed::Delayed<ProtocolLpFeesKey, ProtocolLpFees>,
    /// In MIST.
    creation_fee: blast_admin::delayed::Delayed<CreationFeeKey, u64>,
    partners: blast_partners::partner_list::PartnerList,
}

/// Keys the trade fees' delayed lifecycle.
public struct TradeFeesKey() has copy, drop, store;

/// Blast's share of each asset in a new vault's LP-fee collections, each at most 3,000 bps; the
/// value applied when a launch migrates goes into its vault.
public struct ProtocolLpFees has copy, drop, store {
    meme_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
    quote_bps: blast_core::bps::Bps,
}

/// Keys the venue admissions' delayed lifecycle.
public struct VenueKey() has copy, drop, store;

/// Keys Blast's migration allocation's delayed lifecycle.
public struct ProtocolAllocationKey() has copy, drop, store;

/// Keys Blast's LP-fee share's delayed lifecycle.
public struct ProtocolLpFeesKey() has copy, drop, store;

/// Keys the creation fee's delayed lifecycle.
public struct CreationFeeKey() has copy, drop, store;
```

```move
/// Admits a venue's witness type after the applied admission delay. An admitted venue's tickets
/// start launches, and only that venue redeems their migrations; existing launches keep their
/// venue. Rescheduling a pending admission restarts its delay.
///
/// Primitive and framework types are rejected because anyone can construct them.
public fun schedule_venue<Venue: drop>(
    self: &mut LaunchConfig,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_core::blast_domain::VenueAdmin>,

)

    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_core::blast_domain::VenueAdmin>,
)

    self: &mut LaunchConfig,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_core::blast_domain::VenueAdmin>,

    self: &mut LaunchConfig,

    clock: &Clock,
)

/// Cancels only the admission-delay proposal.

    self: &mut LaunchConfig,
    package_version: &blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    _: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_core::blast_domain::CancelAdmin>,
)

/// Clears the requested pause bits once every launchpad delay and the core treasury's delay are
/// guarded: nonzero, with no pending change that would set one to zero and no pending admission.
/// A delay left at its zero publication value therefore blocks release instead of going live; the
/// generic administration then checks the upgrade delay and the pinned witness. Claims and
/// opening-round delivery never require unpausing; settling an opening round needs the trading
/// bit clear.
public fun unpause(
    self: &LaunchConfig,
    package_version: &mut blast_admin::package_version::PackageVersion<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    unpause_admin: &blast_admin::blast_acl::AdminWitness<blast_admin::package_admin::UnpauseAdmin<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>>,
    package_admin: &blast_admin::package_admin::PackageAdmin<blast_fun::BLAST_FUN>,
    runtime_config: &runtime_config::RuntimeConfig,
    treasury: &blast_core::blast_treasury::Treasury,
    bits: u8,
)
```
